mostWorthwhile.text: The prism comparison was most worthwhile: a second prism and recombination distinguish separating colours from creating them.

leastWorthwhile.text: The valve step was useful but mostly preparatory; its significance became clearer when joined to arterial pumping.

surprise.text: The circulation account explicitly acknowledged that the tiny connections through tissues had not yet been seen.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the circulation steps were the only offered combinations, so their compatibility was not something I discovered.

continue.text: Yes. The concise explanations and attention to what the evidence does and does not establish make another chapter appealing, although the forced sequence leaves little room for choice.
